subject: Reducing inference costs for Orion — batching & caching next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir.desai@orionfintech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Reducing inference costs for Orion — batching & caching next steps

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the call today — appreciate the context on Orion's ML serving patterns. Quick recap and the next steps we agreed on.

High-level pain points you shared
- Token spend is the biggest variable in your monthly ops (current ballpark: ~90M tokens/month across prod & staging).
- Peak traffic spikes (external user queries) force you into expensive burst capacity today; this causes >=2x month-to-month cost variability.
- Latency-sensitive flows (wallet verification, onboarding) need p50 <250ms; current tail latency occasionally breaches SLA.

Goals we want to hit
- Reduce overall inference cost by ~35-50% within the first 90 days via batching, KV/prefix caching, and model quantization where acceptable.
- Keep p50 latency under 250ms for critical flows and p95 within agreed thresholds via smart routing.
- Provide a 12-month TCO projection to match your $150k annual target and show ROI vs current provider.

Back-of-envelope (today's inputs)
- Current monthly token: ~90M
- Target unit cost reduction: 40% -> projected monthly spend target: ~$7k–9k (depending on caching/batching realization)

Attachments I’m including to get us started:
- Redwood-TCO-template.xlsx (xlsx) — editable TCO model; I’ll populate with assumptions from today’s notes
- orion-sample-usage-202602.jsonl (jsonl) — small sample of your anonymized request distribution (thanks for sharing)

Immediate next steps
1) I’ll send a populated TCO model by EOD tomorrow with three scenarios (conservative / expected / aggressive).
2) Schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive with Dev Patel to validate caching strategy and batching expectations (Dev can show a quick perf run and cache TTL tradeoffs).
3) You to share a 30-day token-level usage export (if possible) and the list of top 25 prompts (by frequency) so we can size prefix caching.

Proposed times for the technical call: Thu 3/4 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 3/5 9:00–9:30 PT — tell me what works and I’ll send calendar invites.

Thanks again — excited to help you get predictable pricing without degrading UX.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: Redwood-TCO-template.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: orion-sample-usage-202602.jsonl (jsonl)
From: Samir Desai <samir.desai@orionfintech.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reducing inference costs for Orion — batching & caching next steps

Marissa,

Appreciate the detailed recap — this aligns with what we discussed.
A couple clarifications from my side:
- Budget: our procurement target for inference is $150k/year (so roughly $12.5k/month). We need to show how Redwood would stay within that given expected growth.
- Compliance: for EU customers we may need data residency; it's not a blocker for the initial pilot but something Laura (cc’d below) will want on the security checklist.

I’ll pull the 30-day token usage and top prompt list — give me a day to sanitise and share.

Also: would like to see an example of Dedicated vs Hosted TCO (how much of a delta for reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go), and any quick wins you expect from prefix caching + moderate quantization.

Laura Chen <laura.chen@orionfintech.com> — Laura will be our security lead for this engagement.

Proposed time for the technical call: Fri 3/5 09:00 PT works for me. If you can send a calendar invite, we’ll confirm.

Thanks,

Samir Desai
Head of Platform Engineering
Orion Fintech
samir.desai@orionfintech.com | +1 (617) 555-0198

- 10m: current usage & target metrics (you + Samir)
- 15m: Dev walkthrough — batching/caching/quantization tradeoffs
- 5m: alignment on next deliverables and pilot timeline

Ask for your prep (one pager):
- Top 25 prompts by frequency
- 30-day token export (anonymised)
- Any SLA/region requirements (EU residency for subset)

I’ll also add a short section in HubSpot with the TCO scenarios and link to the shared Drive file.

See you on Friday.
